title: Model attach config (mpi-model-attach)
description: Add or remove skills, and load extra extensions, from rules matched against the current model. Skills rewrite the system prompt. Extensions load on session_start and when the model changes; already-loaded factories stay loaded.

skills.description: Per-model skill add/remove. Omitted: no skill rewrite.

enabled.description: false stops applying skill rules. Default true.

extensions.description: Per-model extension load. Omitted: no dynamic loads.

enabled.description: false stops applying extension rules. Default true.

match.description: All present conditions must hold for the rule to apply.

missingInput.description: Every listed modality must be absent from the model's inputs.

hasInput.description: Every listed modality must be present on the model's inputs.

add.description: Skills: names from the discovered pool or absolute SKILL.md paths. Extensions: entry paths or friendly names under <agentDir>/extensions/<name>. $ENV vars expand; relative paths are rejected.

remove.description: Skills: skill names to detach. Extensions: friendly names (path basename / package dir) whose adds are dropped from this package's load plan.
